protocolRefs.multiCallChain: HTTP client protocol: HTTP AUTHENTICATE / HTTP SET OPTION / HTTP SET CERTIFICATES FOLDER configure per-process client state -> HTTP Get or HTTP Request issues the request and consumes that state -> HTTP GET OPTION / HTTP Get certificates folder read back the currently active state.

overloadMerges.note: The parameter table marks value with the '<-' return arrow (it is filled by the command), so its direction should be 'out', not the mechanical parser's blanket 'in'.

params.name: option
params.description: Code of the HTTP client option whose current value to retrieve (one of the HTTP Client theme option constants).

params.name: value
params.description: Filled with the current value of option (its default, or the last value set via HTTP SET OPTION).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the current value of an HTTP client option that will be used by the next request issued via HTTP Get or HTTP Request.

constraints: Options are local to the current process (or, inside a component, to the executing component).
